name: OBD Y-Splitter (Deutsch DT 6P)
description: 1:1 pass-through Y-adapter on the Harley M8 diagnostic port. Bike side DT06-6S -> two DT04-6P branches (Jekill & Hyde stays connected + RoundDash CAN tap). Pin 2 CAN high (W/R), pin 3 ground (BK), pin 4 accessory power (R/Y), pin 5 CAN low (W/BK); pins 1 and 6 unused.
notes: Pinout confirmed from the 2019 Softail service manual, table A-39 'OBD [91C]'. Connector [91] DLC, 6-place Deutsch DT sealed, behind the left side cover. Pin 4 is SWITCHED accessory power supplied by the BCM - not permanent 12 V - so the display can be fed straight from the Y adapter. CAN runs as a twisted pair W/BK + W/R; keep the twist in the adapter. No termination resistor in the stub (~60 Ohm across pins 2 and 5 with ignition off is a quick sanity check).
